briefing: Stocks fell broadly today, with the tech-heavy NASDAQ down 2.2% and the S&P 500 down 1.1%, so the screener returned no candidates. We are holding all 7 positions and adding nothing, keeping $645.88 in cash. The automatic stop-losses and profit targets will still protect the portfolio, which is up 49.9% overall.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-off is when investors get nervous and sell riskier assets like growth and tech stocks, moving into safer places such as cash or bonds. Tech-heavy indexes like the NASDAQ usually fall harder than the overall market on these days. Pausing new buys during risk-off avoids buying into falling prices, while your existing protections such as stop-losses stay in place.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險情緒」（Risk-Off）是指投資者轉趨審慎，沽售科技股、成長股等高風險資產，轉投現金或債券等較安全的避風港。在這類交易日，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數跌幅往往大於大市。避險情緒升溫時暫停建倉，可避免在跌市中盲目接貨，而止蝕等既有風險管理機制則繼續發揮保護作用。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks fell across the board today, and tech led the way down: the NASDAQ lost 2.2%, about twice the S&P 500's 1.1% drop. When tech falls faster than the broad market, it usually means investors are moving out of high-valuation growth stocks and into safer assets. No news headlines were supplied for today's session, so this summary describes the price action only and does not name a specific cause.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全線受壓，科技股跌幅尤為顯著：納斯達克指數下挫2.2%，跌幅約為標普500指數（跌1.1%）的兩倍。科技股跑輸大市，通常反映資金正撤出高估值成長股，轉投較具防守性的資產。由於今日未有相關新聞資料，以上分析僅就盤面走勢而論，未能指出具體觸發因素。
